articleTitle: Oral Cancer: Signs, Diagnosis, and Treatment Basics

linkedin.content:
Don't ignore that mouth sore. It could be more than just a nuisance.

Oral cancer, a type of head and neck cancer, can affect the lips, tongue, gums, and lining of the mouth. In India, tobacco use – whether chewed or smoked – is a major risk factor. Common warning signs include sores that don't heal, lumps, white or red patches, bleeding, and difficulty swallowing. These symptoms aren't always cancer, but persistent issues need evaluation.

Early detection is key. Regular dental visits are crucial, especially for tobacco users. Diagnosis involves physical exams, biopsies, and imaging. Treatment options include surgery, radiation, and chemotherapy, tailored to the individual. In India, Ayushman Bharat (PM-JAY) may cover cancer treatment costs for eligible families.

If you notice any concerning changes in your mouth, consult a doctor or dentist promptly. Early diagnosis significantly improves treatment outcomes.

twitter.content:
1/ Is that mouth sore just not healing? It could be more than just a nuisance. Oral cancer can affect lips, tongue, gums, & more. Know the signs. If you're worried, consult a doctor.

2/ Tobacco use – gutka, paan masala, bidi, cigarettes – is a MAJOR risk factor for oral cancer in India. Quitting can significantly improve your health. Speak to an oncologist about your risk.

3/ Watch out for these warning signs: sores that don't heal, lumps, white/red patches, bleeding, numbness, voice changes, or trouble swallowing. These aren't *always* cancer, but get checked!

4/ Regular dental visits are crucial! Oral cancer can be found during routine checkups, even without obvious symptoms. Early detection is key.

5/ A biopsy is the ONLY way to confirm oral cancer. If your doctor recommends one, it's to rule out cancer or plan treatment, not a confirmed diagnosis. Don't panic, get informed.

6/ Treatment for oral cancer can include surgery, radiation, and/or chemotherapy. For tobacco users, quitting BEFORE treatment improves recovery chances.

7/ Know the signs, reduce your risk, and seek medical attention for persistent issues. Your health matters! Learn more about oral cancer: https://suchitracancercare.org/cancer-type/oral-cancer/

youtube_short.content:
Hey everyone, did you know oral cancer is a serious concern, especially here in India? Let's talk about it.

First, oral cancer starts in the mouth – that includes your lips, tongue, gums, and even the lining of your cheeks. It's one type of head and neck cancer.

Second, watch out for warning signs. These can be a sore in your mouth that won't heal, a lump or thickening, or white or red patches. You might also notice bleeding, pain, numbness, or changes in your voice. Loose teeth or trouble swallowing are other things to look for.

Third, certain things increase your risk. Tobacco use – like gutka, paan masala, khaini, bidi, and cigarettes – is a big one. Heavy alcohol use and too much sun exposure also play a role.

Now, what should you do? If you notice any of these warning signs that last for more than 2-3 weeks, please see a doctor or dentist. Regular dental checkups are also a good idea, especially if you use tobacco. They can help catch problems early.

Want to learn more about oral cancer, including symptoms, risk factors, and treatment options? Visit https://suchitracancercare.org/cancer-type/oral-cancer/ for more information. Stay informed and stay healthy!
